name: Airbnb
description: 珊瑚紅與圓角，讓探索成為主角。
brief: A stay-discovery page with a compact destination search, a horizontally scrollable category rail, and photo-led listing cards. Keep location, dates, and guest count separately labeled; make saving a listing a real toggle.
component: a stay card with a save toggle, a rating, and a clearly separated nightly rate

name: Airtable
description: 彩色分區，把複雜資訊整理清楚。
brief: A team planning workspace with a view switcher, grouped records, and an editable detail drawer. Use distinct category colors without turning every cell into a badge; preserve column alignment as content grows.
component: a record detail panel with labeled fields and an explicit save state

name: Apple
description: 大幅留白，讓產品與文字自己說話。
brief: A product introduction with a single object as the visual anchor, short centered headlines, and quiet comparison sections. Preserve generous vertical pauses and use blue only for useful actions or links.
component: a product comparison row that keeps specifications aligned across screen sizes

name: Binance
description: 深色底與黃色重點，資訊一眼可辨。
brief: A market watch interface with a searchable asset list and an informational detail panel. Keep tabular numerals aligned, distinguish direction with signs as well as color, and label every value as sample data.
component: an asset row with a favorite toggle and positive, negative, and unavailable states

name: BMW
description: 精準網格搭配深淺交錯的產品敘事。
brief: A vehicle discovery page with a wide visual introduction, body-style filters, and a specification comparison. Keep photography subordinate to readable controls, and make selected filters obvious without extra decorative gradients.
component: a vehicle selection card with specifications and a compare toggle

name: BMW M
description: 黑色舞台、緊密字級與少量賽車色彩。
brief: A performance collection with strong uppercase chapter titles, compact engineering figures, and a restrained tricolor detail. Let specifications and image proportions establish intensity; do not add racing stripes to every surface.
component: a performance specification strip with accessible labels and units

name: Bugatti
description: 近乎純黑的畫布，搭配雕塑般的比例。
brief: A limited-series showcase with monumental typography, large image intervals, and a small editorial story section. Keep navigation and actions sparse; a change in scale should carry emphasis before adding color.
component: an editorial vehicle feature with a caption, specifications, and one next action

name: Cal.com
description: 中性色與清楚的表單層級，專注排程。
brief: A meeting-booking flow with a month picker, available time slots, and a confirmation summary. Communicate timezone before selection; support unavailable dates, keyboard navigation, and a reversible selected slot.
component: a time-slot picker with available, selected, and unavailable states

name: Claude
description: 奶油色、陶土色與襯線標題的溫暖節奏。
brief: A writing-assistant introduction pairing editorial serif headlines with a working draft panel. Balance the warm page canvas with one dark technical example; reserve coral for the action that advances the workflow.
component: a draft review card with source text, an editable response, and a clear apply action

name: Clay
description: 柔和暖色與不規則構圖，保留創作空間。
brief: A creative studio portfolio built around asymmetric case-study layouts and soft neutral surfaces. Alternate large visual blocks with concise project context; allow the work to define the palette within a stable page frame.
component: a case-study tile with project discipline, image caption, and a readable text link

name: ClickHouse
description: 近黑底色與明亮黃色，清楚展示技術。
brief: An analytics engine introduction with an executable-looking query sample, a results table, and a compact architecture explanation. Use yellow for orientation and primary actions; retain monospace alignment without shrinking the text.
component: a query result panel with column headers, units, and an empty-result state

name: Cohere
description: 中性閱讀面搭配低彩度產品色塊。
brief: An enterprise knowledge workspace with a source list, answer panel, and citation rail. Separate source evidence from generated content visually; use soft colored groupings and a dark console only where technical detail benefits.
component: a cited answer card with expandable sources and a no-results state

name: Coinbase
description: 白底與鮮明藍色，建立有秩序的閱讀體驗。
brief: An educational asset dashboard with a balanced overview, watchlist, and explanatory detail area. Prefer generous white surfaces and a clear blue action hierarchy; mark all financial figures as examples.
component: a watchlist card with sample balance, change indicators, and explanatory tooltips

name: Composio
description: 黑色介面與電藍色訊號，凸顯整合流程。
brief: An integration explorer organized by service category with a connection detail panel. Keep the frame nearly black, use blue to indicate the current step, and show connection status in words as well as icons.
component: an integration connection card with disconnected, connecting, connected, and error states

name: Cursor
description: 暖灰紙感與精簡編輯器，呈現開發細節。
brief: A coding-tool page on a warm neutral canvas with a readable editor example and a short release list. Use an orange accent sparingly; keep code and prose at distinct densities without decorative syntax walls.
component: an editor change preview that separates additions, removals, and the accept action

name: Dell (1996)
description: 色塊與復古排版，重現早期網頁型錄感。
brief: A retro computer catalog with a black outer frame, strong flat-color feature blocks, and readable serif descriptions. Recreate the period through borders and type rather than inaccessible fixed-width layouts or obsolete markup.
component: a retro specification card with a chunky heading, a flat highlight strip, and a real link

name: ElevenLabs
description: 乾淨石色、聲音波形與細膩的文字層次。
brief: An audio project workspace with a transcript, voice selector, and compact waveform player. Keep the layout light and tactile; playback must expose play, pause, elapsed time, and a textual status without depending on animation.
component: an audio preview card with playback controls and a transcript disclosure

name: Expo
description: 清爽中性色與藍色重點，聚焦開發流程。
brief: A mobile development overview pairing a device-sized preview with a short build log and platform selector. Keep the surrounding layout quiet and give the active platform a single consistent blue indicator.
component: a build-status card with queued, running, successful, and failed states

name: Ferrari
description: 黑白光影與克制的紅色，帶出速度感。
brief: An automotive editorial page with alternating dark and light story chapters and a concise model summary. Reserve red for deliberate emphasis; use strong image crops and uppercase headings to establish pace.
component: a model story panel with a visual caption and an accessible specification disclosure

name: Figma
description: 大膽色塊、俐落黑線與充滿活力的構圖。
brief: A collaborative design workshop page with a generous hero, colored project tiles, and a small shared-canvas demonstration. Keep outlines crisp and use color to distinguish spaces; avoid applying all available colors to one component.
component: a workshop card with participant initials, project status, and a join action

name: Framer
description: 深色展示舞台與電藍色，突出作品品質。
brief: A portfolio publishing page with a strong project preview, a compact feature sequence, and a template gallery. Use a dark frame and blue actions, and ensure any motion has an equally informative static version.
component: a template preview card with viewport choices and a single publish-style demo action

name: HashiCorp
description: 規律黑白網格，承載多產品技術資訊。
brief: An infrastructure product directory with aligned product families, code examples, and a workflow diagram. Keep the overall frame monochrome; use each product accent only inside its own labeled context.
component: an infrastructure resource panel with a status label and expandable configuration

name: HP
description: 白色版面與電藍色，配合俐落幾何切角。
brief: A device catalog with task-based filters, a product comparison strip, and a small support area. Let blue chevron-like details guide reading without replacing conventional buttons or obscuring product imagery.
component: a device comparison card with ports, weight, and a selected-for-comparison state

name: IBM
description: 嚴謹網格、方角元件與清楚的藍色層級。
brief: An enterprise operations dashboard using a structured column grid and compact but readable tables. Align every field and keep corners restrained; use blue for selection and avoid shadows when dividers already establish hierarchy.
component: a data table toolbar with search, row selection, and bulk-action feedback

name: Intercom
description: 暖白底與橙色訊號，讓對話更有親和力。
brief: A support inbox with a conversation list, readable thread, and customer context panel. Use warm neutral surfaces and a focused orange action; distinguish agent messages, customer messages, and system events structurally.
component: a conversation composer with draft, sending, sent, and retry states

name: Kraken
description: 紫色按鈕與冷灰中性色，保持清楚可信。
brief: An informational market overview on a white canvas with purple actions and rounded rectangular cards. Use clear number alignment and concise explanations, keeping all displayed market values explicitly illustrative.
component: an asset summary with a labeled range selector and an unavailable-data message

name: Lamborghini
description: 純黑、大寫字級與金色細節，凝聚視線。
brief: A dramatic vehicle collection with spacious black sections, strong uppercase labels, and gold accents at decision points. Use angular alignment and one visual focal point per section; keep controls legible over imagery.
component: a technical feature panel with an image caption and a keyboard-operable detail toggle

name: Linear
description: 近黑分層與薰衣草色，精準呈現產品資訊。
brief: An issue workspace with a narrow project rail, a dense issue list, and a contextual detail panel. Use near-black layers and hairline borders; lavender should signal selection or the next action instead of decorating every card.
component: an issue row with status, priority, assignee, and an accessible selection state

name: Lovable
description: 奶油色、柔和邊框與深色操作按鈕。
brief: A project-start page with a generous brief composer, suggested starting points, and a compact recent-project gallery. Keep the warm canvas visible around the content and use an inset dark button as the main action.
component: a project brief composer with example suggestions, validation, and a generation status

name: Mastercard
description: 溫暖米色與圓弧構圖，讓內容輕鬆流動。
brief: A payment-services information page with cream reading sections, rounded image windows, and orange-red emphasis. Explain the service through short chapters and keep circle motifs decorative rather than using them as unlabeled controls.
component: a service benefit card with an orbital image crop and a concise text action

name: Meta
description: 大幅影像與藍色操作，建立明確產品層次。
brief: A connected-device showcase alternating bright product sections with dark immersive examples. Keep the primary blue action consistent and provide a comparison path that does not depend on scrolling through every photograph.
component: a device feature selector with a visible selected state and descriptive captions

name: MiniMax
description: 多產品色彩配合輕量網格，保持技術可讀性。
brief: An AI model explorer with capability filters, a model detail sheet, and a small playground example. Use product colors only to identify model families and preserve a neutral frame for technical specifications.
component: a model capability card with supported modalities, context details, and availability

name: Mintlify
description: 綠色點綴與閱讀導向的文件結構。
brief: A documentation portal with a stable left navigation, central article, and compact on-page outline. Make code examples horizontally scrollable, keep green for current context and useful actions, and make search keyboard accessible.
component: a documentation code example with language tabs and a copy action

name: Miro
description: 明亮黃色與便箋色彩，讓協作空間有秩序。
brief: A workshop board overview with template cards, participant presence, and a small canvas preview. Use yellow to establish the workspace identity, and group sticky-note colors by meaning rather than distributing them randomly.
component: a workshop template card with preview notes, duration, and a start action

name: Mistral AI
description: 暖黃與橙色像素節奏，帶出開放技術感。
brief: An open-model directory with an orange-and-cream editorial header and compact model specifications. Use pixel-like geometry sparingly as separators; let task labels and readable technical tables carry the content.
component: a model specification card with context size, license information, and a download link

name: MongoDB
description: 深青綠與鮮綠色，連接資料與開發者體驗。
brief: A document database explorer with a collection rail, readable JSON detail, and an example query panel. Combine deep teal structure with selective green actions; keep nested data expandable without relying on tiny targets.
component: a collection summary with document count, index status, and an empty-collection state

name: Nike
description: 巨大標題、黑白對比與影像優先的編排。
brief: An athletic collection lookbook with oversized concise headings and a practical product grid. Keep the interface monochrome so product images provide the color; allow filters and size selection to work independently of the hero.
component: a product card with size availability, a save toggle, and an accessible image description

name: Nintendo (2001)
description: 金屬框、琥珀色導覽與遊戲盒式的懷舊編排。
brief: A retro game discovery portal with beveled periwinkle panels, compact amber navigation, and box-art-sized content slots. Preserve the playful early-web atmosphere while using semantic controls and fluid mobile stacking.
component: a game feature panel with a beveled frame, genre label, and expandable details

name: Notion
description: 文件式結構與柔和色面，讓知識容易整理。
brief: A team knowledge home with an editable-looking page title, linked document cards, and a quiet sidebar. Keep the reading column comfortable, use icons as secondary orientation, and make document status explicit.
component: a linked-document card with owner, last-edited label, and a favorite toggle

name: NVIDIA
description: 黑色與鮮綠色構成高對比的技術舞台。
brief: A computing platform overview with a strong green action, dark technical sections, and a clear benchmark explainer. Treat performance numbers as labeled examples and use concise tabular comparisons rather than decorative gauges.
component: a compute specification card with units, sample performance, and a detail disclosure

name: Ollama
description: 單色、終端機範例與直白的內容結構。
brief: A local-model library with search, a compact model list, and a readable installation snippet. Let text and spacing carry the hierarchy; show platform-specific commands and provide a real copy button.
component: a model download panel with a size label, platform selector, and copyable command

name: OpenCode
description: 暖灰紙面搭配深色終端機，保持工具感。
brief: A terminal coding assistant page with a warm neutral outer frame and a clearly bounded command demo. Keep monospaced hints legible and separate typed input from generated output without relying on color alone.
component: a terminal command panel with a copy action, output region, and explicit execution status

name: Pinterest
description: 紅色操作與瀑布流，讓視覺收藏容易瀏覽。
brief: A visual inspiration board with variable-height image cards, labeled topic filters, and a save-to-board interaction. Use red for the key action and preserve reading order when the masonry layout collapses on mobile.
component: an inspiration card with a visible title, image description, and save-state feedback

name: PlayStation
description: 藍色訊號配合深淺章節，營造遊戲展示感。
brief: A game discovery page with a featured title, horizontally scrollable releases, and platform filters. Keep blue as the stable navigation signal; provide text equivalents for image-heavy game announcements.
component: a game release card with platform labels, availability, and a wishlist toggle

name: PostHog
description: 暖灰與黃色細節，兼顧密集資訊和趣味。
brief: A product analytics overview with concise insight cards, an events table, and a friendly onboarding hint. Keep the content dense but aligned, and use yellow for actionable moments without reproducing mascot artwork.
component: an event insight card with a sample trend, date range, and a no-data explanation

name: Raycast
description: 黑色指令視窗與細膩的強調色，快速而直接。
brief: A command-launcher interface with a centered search field, grouped results, and visible keyboard hints. Keep the dark surface compact and distinguish the focused result through both a background and a clear label.
component: a command result row with icon placeholder, shortcut hint, and focused state

name: Renault
description: 俐落方角與明亮色帶，形成大膽的章節感。
brief: An electric vehicle guide with bold chapter headings, restrained yellow controls, and a practical model comparison. Let gradients occupy only dedicated image areas, keeping text and forms on stable solid surfaces.
component: a model comparison selector with range, charging details, and explicit units

name: Replicate
description: 輕量白底、模型範例與可閱讀的程式碼。
brief: A model playground with a labeled input form, generated-output area, and an API example. Use a sparse warm-white frame and reserve the red-orange accent for the run action; include queued and failed output states.
component: a model input panel with validation, sample input, and an output status region

name: Resend
description: 近黑底色、單色字級與精簡開發者介面。
brief: An email delivery dashboard with a compact activity table, message detail, and a code example. Use bright text and subtle dark borders; status chips must include words and timestamps must have an explicit timezone.
component: an email activity row with delivered, pending, and bounced states

name: Revolut
description: 俐落字級與深淺卡片，整理多種金融資訊。
brief: A personal finance concept dashboard with account summaries, category filters, and a transaction detail sheet. Keep the typography crisp and mark balances as sample data; use color for hierarchy instead of invented performance claims.
component: a transaction detail card with sample amount, currency, category, and status

name: Runway
description: 電影式暗場搭配白色閱讀區，讓作品成為焦點。
brief: A film project gallery with wide visual previews, a quiet editorial introduction, and concise production notes. Avoid autoplay as the only way to understand a project; pair each preview with a useful still image and caption.
component: a film project card with duration, format, caption, and play-pause controls

name: Sanity
description: 大字級、近黑底與珊瑚紅，清楚呈現內容工作流。
brief: A content operations page with a strong editorial header, schema example, and structured workflow panels. Keep coral for the highest-priority action and use monospaced labels only for technical metadata.
component: a content status panel with draft, review, and published stages

name: Sentry
description: 紫黑底與亮色狀態，協助快速定位問題。
brief: An error triage workspace with an issue list, a stack trace, and release context. Use a deep purple frame and reserve bright accents for severity or selection; keep the trace readable and allow long paths to wrap or scroll.
component: an error summary card with severity, first-seen time, and an acknowledge action

name: Shopify
description: 黑色與柔綠色面，讓商業展示保有呼吸感。
brief: A storefront tools overview with a dark introduction, calm merchant examples, and a product-management preview. Use light display typography and green accents selectively; demonstrate useful actions with clearly labeled sample products.
component: a product-management card with inventory state and an editable publishing status

name: Slack
description: 茄紫色配合奶油底與圓角按鈕，突出協作。
brief: A team collaboration home with a channel overview, a conversation preview, and a concise activity list. Let aubergine frame the navigation and use cream reading areas; distinguish unread activity without relying only on a colored dot.
component: a channel activity card with unread count, participant initials, and a follow toggle

name: SpaceX
description: 黑白全幅敘事，以影像與大字級建立張力。
brief: A mission archive with large visual chapter openings, concise mission facts, and a chronological index. Keep the palette monochrome and allow imagery to lead while preserving readable navigation and captions.
component: a mission summary with date, status, and an expandable technical fact list

name: Spotify
description: 深色分層與鮮綠色操作，配合封面主導的編排。
brief: A listening library with album-like tiles, a focused detail view, and a persistent player. Use green for the main playback action and keep the player usable with keyboard input, long titles, and unavailable tracks.
component: a playlist row with play-pause control, duration, and a saved state

name: Starbucks
description: 多層綠色與暖奶油底，呈現親切日常感。
brief: A cafe menu explorer with image-led categories, seasonal highlights, and a location information panel. Use deep green for structure, lighter green for support, and pill-shaped actions with clear text.
component: a drink detail card with size options, ingredient disclosure, and selection feedback

name: Stripe
description: 深藍字色、靛紫操作與輕盈的漸層空間。
brief: A payment infrastructure page with light-weight display type, a restrained gradient header, and a useful transaction demo. Keep numbers aligned and sample-labeled; use clean white sections to make the technical explanation readable.
component: a sample transaction summary with currency, status, and expandable line items

name: Supabase
description: 炭黑面板與翡翠綠，呈現實際開發工作。
brief: A backend project dashboard with a table browser, connection example, and compact project health summary. Build depth with dark surfaces and fine borders; reserve green for active selections and successful outcomes.
component: a database connection card with environment label, masked example value, and copy feedback

name: Superhuman
description: 深紫與暖白的輕盈對比，聚焦鍵盤效率。
brief: An email productivity concept with a quiet inbox, an expanded reading pane, and visible shortcuts. Alternate warm neutral reading surfaces with deep violet framing; prioritize clear selection and rapid scanning over decorative glow.
component: an inbox row with read-unread state, sender, subject, and shortcut hints

name: Tesla
description: 全幅視覺與極少元件，留下清楚的行動路徑。
brief: A vehicle overview built from spacious full-height chapters with concise centered titles and a small action cluster. Keep controls on readable backing surfaces and retain a useful fallback when images cannot load.
component: a model choice panel with a short specification list and two clearly ranked actions

name: The Verge
description: 酸綠與紫色交錯，搭配有力的編輯字級。
brief: A technology magazine front page with a dominant lead story, sharply separated topic bands, and dense secondary headlines. Give mint and violet distinct editorial roles and keep metadata quieter than story titles.
component: a story card with section label, author, timestamp, and a readable headline hierarchy

name: Together AI
description: 黑白結構與柔和色塊，整理多層技術內容。
brief: An inference platform overview with model categories, benchmark explanations, and a short API walkthrough. Use soft accent panels as chapter markers; ensure sample metrics have units and never imply live availability.
component: a model endpoint panel with sample request, response, and copy feedback

name: Uber
description: 純黑與白色、粗體字級與直接的操作流程。
brief: A trip-planning concept with labeled pickup and destination fields, a route summary, and service options. Keep the layout bold and practical; demonstrate location inputs with sample places rather than requesting real location access.
component: a service option card with sample arrival time, capacity, and selected state

name: Vercel
description: 黑白幾何與細線網格，凸顯產品精度。
brief: A deployment overview with project cards, a recent build list, and a readable log panel. Use monochrome surfaces, hairline divisions, and restrained blue status accents; avoid decorative gradients behind operational information.
component: a deployment row with environment, commit label, status, and a log disclosure

name: Vodafone
description: 紅色章節與大字標題，清楚傳達服務。
brief: A connectivity services page with bold red chapter bands, a coverage explainer, and a device support grid. Keep body copy on stable neutral surfaces and use short labeled comparisons instead of overwhelming badge clusters.
component: a connectivity feature card with speed units, availability note, and detail toggle

name: VoltAgent
description: 終端機式黑底與翡翠色，讓代理工作流可見。
brief: An agent workflow dashboard with a run timeline, step details, and a readable tool-call example. Keep the frame nearly black and use emerald to indicate active progress; distinguish completed, waiting, and failed steps in text.
component: an agent run step with duration, status, and expandable input-output details

name: Warp
description: 暖灰終端機與區塊式指令，兼顧工具感與閱讀。
brief: A terminal workspace concept with separate command blocks, readable output, and a small command-history rail. Use the warm neutral palette from the analysis and make each block independently copyable without adding ornamental chrome.
component: a command history block with input, output, timestamp, and copy feedback

name: Webflow
description: 大膽黑白區塊與亮藍色，配合精準版面結構。
brief: A visual site-building overview with a canvas preview, component navigator, and concise publishing checklist. Keep blue for editing context and useful actions; show a clear distinction between canvas content and application controls.
component: a component navigator row with nesting, visibility state, and keyboard focus

name: WIRED
description: 報紙式密度、襯線標題與精簡藍色連結。
brief: A long-form technology journal with a strong serif headline, compact byline, and multi-column related stories. Establish hierarchy with rules and type scale; keep the article column comfortable and avoid card shadows.
component: an editorial story summary with byline, reading time, and topic label

name: Wise
description: 鮮綠色與深綠字色，讓數字和步驟清晰可讀。
brief: A transfer calculator concept with two labeled currency inputs, a fee breakdown, and a clear review step. Use green for the primary action and mark rates as examples; expose every calculation assumption in the summary.
component: a sample conversion summary with source amount, fee, rate, and destination amount

name: xAI
description: 克制黑白與寬闊留白，保持技術敘事的焦點。
brief: A research model page with a quiet monochrome header, a concise capability list, and a readable technical appendix. Use scale and spacing for emphasis; reserve any accent for a meaningful state rather than atmosphere.
component: a research release card with version, date, capability summary, and detail link

name: Zapier
description: 暖白與亮橙色，將自動化步驟排列清楚。
brief: An automation builder concept with a trigger, an ordered action sequence, and a test-result panel. Use orange to mark the current step, keep connectors semantically labeled, and show incomplete configuration before allowing a demo run.
component: an automation step with setup, ready, running, and failed states
